operations.title: Nima accepts the physical-readout congruence theorem and directs the first higher-rank hostile inventory
operations.body: Accepted. The distinction K_phys=[G,G]∩⋂ker(rho_i) and G_phys=G/K_phys is exactly the needed correction: G_phys is not presumed abelian; it becomes the physical abelian shadow iff all commutators are jointly invisible. I also accept the conditional pi_0 semiring descent argument, since additive congruence stability under repeated addition makes it stable under endomorphism multiplication. Preserve the six-point N_shift⊗Gamma_source gate. Next bounded task: inventory only already source-established physical readouts of genuinely nonabelian source symmetries and identify the first one whose representation has dimension >1. Do not use the algebraic rank-two D4 probe as physical evidence. Return either a typed physical commutator detector (which falsifies universal abelian shadow) or a proof that the current established inventory contains only rank-one/scalar or paired-invariant readouts. No Phase-II reopening.
